what_is_already_solved: optimization with a possibly misspecified model of deployment feedback
what_is_not_solved: EV-specific response identification and grid-safe sequential deployment
implication_for_ev_research: a static OOD formulation misses feedback created by price, routing and dispatch decisions

what_is_already_solved: derivative-free learning under state-dependent controlled Markov data
what_is_not_solved: charging-specific observability, safety and sample efficiency
implication_for_ev_research: repeated charging interventions can be modeled as controlled sequential feedback, but generic theory alone is not novelty

what_is_already_solved: robust optimization under ambiguity in a decision-dependent distribution map
what_is_not_solved: EV calibration, constraints and empirical feedback data
implication_for_ev_research: any performative EV method must benchmark feedback-model misspecification rather than assume a correct response map

what_is_already_solved: learned demand feedback and distributed Nash equilibrium for competing charging operators
what_is_not_solved: probabilistic multi-horizon forecasting, support diagnostics and grid-safe control
implication_for_ev_research: EV pricing-demand performativity is already explicit prior art; a new paper must go beyond merely iterating price and forecast

what_is_already_solved: randomized evidence that capacity tariffs alter EV peak load

what_is_already_solved: TOU pricing shifts charging but can create larger synchronized peaks; managed charging reduces capacity needs
what_is_not_solved: station-level forecasting model and public microdata
implication_for_ev_research: forecast accuracy under the pre-intervention distribution may be irrelevant after coordinated behavioral response

what_is_already_solved: large causal response and cross-app substitution under public charging price cuts
what_is_not_solved: open microdata and grid-constrained forecast-control design
implication_for_ev_research: station demand is endogenous to competitors and apps, not just local history and weather

what_is_already_solved: iterative prediction, expansion and user-behavior feedback
what_is_not_solved: support-aware selective prediction and unknown-feedback guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: new station cold-start must account for network intervention and redistribution, not independently predict each site

what_is_already_solved: new infrastructure changes utilization at both new and existing stations
what_is_not_solved: temporal probabilistic forecasting and safe extrapolation
implication_for_ev_research: structural OOD should be defined as graph intervention plus demand redistribution

what_is_already_solved: learns aggregate EV power bounds, marginal utilities and market bid curves
what_is_not_solved: identifiability from real censored public-station data under changing policy

what_is_already_solved: structural-parametric behavioral inference with domain expertise
what_is_not_solved: operational short-term load and intervention validity
implication_for_ev_research: latent preference learning is high risk because multiple behavioral structures can explain the same aggregate load

what_is_already_solved: scalable route-graph charging-demand surrogate with real truck validation and open data
what_is_not_solved: probabilistic disruptions, depot aggregation and robust rolling dispatch
implication_for_ev_research: fleet/depot is a feasible alternative domain, but plain route-GNN forecasting is already occupied

what_is_already_solved: route energy prediction integrated with open linear depot optimization
what_is_not_solved: uncertain rotations, delays, weather and forecast-risk propagation
implication_for_ev_research: a new depot study must model operational uncertainty rather than repeat deterministic energy prediction plus LP

what_is_already_solved: behavioral mixtures materially alter peak, fluctuation and spatial grid stress
what_is_not_solved: short-term station-level finite-sample tail guarantees
implication_for_ev_research: average error is insufficient; peak/tail consequences should be a required evaluation dimension

what_is_already_solved: tariff-aware co-evolution of mobility and charging choices
what_is_not_solved: field-calibrated feedback and queues/substitution
implication_for_ev_research: price-as-feature is too weak; policy enters the data-generating process

what_is_already_solved: spatial, temporal and economic modalities with price elasticity mechanisms
what_is_not_solved: counterfactual policy validity and performative equilibrium
implication_for_ev_research: causal labels or elasticity modules alone do not prove action-conditioned forecast validity

what_is_already_solved: fluid-queue availability forecasting improves downstream vehicle scheduling
what_is_not_solved: real rejected demand, abandonment and station substitution
implication_for_ev_research: service-realizable load is promising only if queue and lost-demand mechanisms are observable or interval-identified

what_is_already_solved: dual-timescale behavior-guided online probabilistic forecasting
what_is_not_solved: strict unseen-domain support and action-induced feedback
implication_for_ev_research: ordinary behavior drift is no longer a sufficient headline innovation

what_is_already_solved: probability-based new charging-site load planning from traffic, adoption and configuration
what_is_not_solved: auditable model internals and structural OOD uncertainty
implication_for_ev_research: zero-history new-site forecasting already has operational baselines; research must expose failure/support conditions

what_is_already_solved: station assignment and queue equilibrium under travel and wait costs
what_is_not_solved: validation against observed lost demand

what_is_not_solved: partial participation, privacy, observed abandonment/substitution and strict OOD calibration
